Macrons

Consonantal i

Consonantal u

Theme

Civic life: news, government & the law

inform on verb

also rat on, tell on, denounce, snitch on, report someone

classical

Cic. Rosc. Am. 28: nōmen alicujus dē parricīdiō (Lewis & Short)
Traupman 368

dēferō, dēferre, dētulī, dēlātum

verb, conjugation

inform against, denounce (to the authorities)

Classically with nōmen alicujus, “bring someone’s name before the magistrate”; with the person as object from Augustus on (Lewis & Short).

See also charge.

SourcesLewis & Short: defero

John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, p. 368.
